title: Minimum Number of Frogs Croaking
summary: Given a string representing a mix of 'croak' sounds from multiple frogs, determine the least number of frogs needed to produce the entire string.
statement: Given a string representing a mix of 'croak' sounds from multiple frogs, determine the least number of frogs needed to produce the entire string. Each frog must complete a full 'croak' sequence. If the string cannot be formed by valid 'croak' sequences, return -1.
constraints: The input interleaves zero or more simultaneous copies of the exact word croak.
Return the minimum concurrent frogs, or -1 if the sequence is invalid.
hints: Track how many frogs currently wait at each stage of c-r-o-a-k.
A non-c letter must consume a frog from the immediately previous stage.
Increment concurrency at c and decrement it at k.
The maximum active count is necessary and sufficient; leftover stages make the input invalid.
editorial: The maximum active count is necessary and sufficient; leftover stages make the input invalid.

tests.explanation: One frog can finish the first croak before starting the second.
Two croaks overlap, so at least two frogs are active.
